entities.name: Hugs
entities.description: Gruff old badgerfolk mercenary from Goodhill on Bloomburrow and member of Mabel's party, Gev's partner.

entities.name: Gev
entities.description: Lizardfolk who befriended and named Hugs; his partner and fellow mercenary.

entities.name: Kiki
entities.description: Skunkfolk companion of Hugs and Gev.

entities.name: Mabel
entities.description: Leader of the party investigating the destruction of Pondside.

entities.name: Striped Rapscallions
entities.description: Name Hugs, Gev and Kiki gave themselves.

entities.name: Mabel's party
entities.description: The party sent to investigate Pondside's destruction.

entities.name: Three Tree City
entities.description: City attacked by the Flood Gar.

entities.name: Flood Gar
entities.description: Creature that attacked Three Tree City.

events.summary: Hugs fends off a Calamity Beast while Gev leads a town to safety, and is named after the children's hugs.
events.quote: Hugs fended off a Calamity Beast

events.summary: Hugs volunteers to accompany Mabel to investigate Pondside; Gev joins to keep an eye on him.
events.quote: Hugs volunteered to accompany her by standing and nodding his head.

events.summary: Hugs is instrumental in saving the party when the Flood Gar attacks Three Tree City.
events.quote: Hugs was instrumental in saving the lives of the other party members.
